First release of **codex-peek**: a tiny always-on-top window that shows thumbnails of the images you paste into the OpenAI Codex CLI, numbered `Image #1..N` to match the `[Image #N]` placeholders in the composer.

### Highlights
- Native OS webview (WKWebView / WebView2 / WebKitGTK). No Electron, and binaries are about 0.6–0.9 MB.
- **Codex plugin:** the window opens when a Codex session starts (via a tool-less MCP server) and closes when it ends. Lifecycle hooks are a fallback.
- Click to enlarge, **Clear** (numbering restarts), optional `--idle` auto-clear, frameless and draggable, remembers its position.
- `--dir` / `--pattern` overrides. Watches `codex-clipboard-*.png` in the OS temp dir by default.

### Install
```sh
codex plugin marketplace add hucheng91/codex-peek
codex plugin add codex-peek@codex-peek
```
The plugin downloads the right binary from this release on first use. You can also download a binary below and run it directly.

| Asset | Platform |
|---|---|
| `codex-peek-macos-arm64` | macOS Apple Silicon |
| `codex-peek-macos-x64` | macOS Intel |
| `codex-peek-windows-x64.exe` | Windows x64 (needs WebView2, preinstalled on Windows 10/11) |
| `codex-peek-linux-x64` | Linux x64 (needs WebKitGTK 4.1) |
| `SHA256SUMS` | checksums |

### Known limitations
Numbering can drift if you delete placeholders (use Clear). Only clipboard pastes are captured, not file-path or URL images. Binaries are unsigned. Tested end to end with codex-cli 0.162.1 on Linux. See the README.

---

**中文简介**：codex-peek 是一个置顶的小窗口，实时显示你粘贴进 Codex CLI 的图片缩略图，编号和输入框里的 `[Image #N]` 一致。它使用系统自带的 WebView，二进制不到 1 MB。作为 Codex 插件安装后，窗口会随会话自动打开和关闭。安装方式：`codex plugin marketplace add hucheng91/codex-peek`，然后执行 `codex plugin add codex-peek@codex-peek`。
